slides.texte_overlay:
quiet signs you're smarter
than you think

you doubt yourself

you question your own answers before you trust them. people who know a lot also know how much they don't know, so a little self doubt is often a sign of a sharp mind.

you get bored easily

small talk and repetition drain you fast. a mind that needs new ideas to stay awake is usually a mind that is constantly looking for something worth chewing on.

you love odd questions

you wonder why cats purr or how old the moon is. curiosity is the habit behind most smart people, and feeding it a little every day makes it grow stronger.
slides.texte_sophia:
you love odd questions

i used to scroll whenever i was curious. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, like why cats purr, and my curiosity finally feels fed instead of wasted.

slides.texte_overlay:
you talk to yourself

you think out loud when you solve problems. saying your thoughts in words slows them down and organises them, which is exactly why it helps you find better answers.

you notice small details

you spot the tiny things others miss: a change in tone, a crooked frame, a pattern in numbers. paying close attention is one of the quietest signs of intelligence.
